source.title: Diabetes Prevalence and Incidence Among Medicare Beneficiaries — United States, 2001–2015
source.location: Abstract and Results: 2015 overall prevalence 31.6% (Table overall row, index year 2015)
source.citation: Andes LJ, Li Y, Srinivasan M, Benoit SR, Gregg E, Rolka DB. MMWR. 2019;68(43):961-966.

population.enrollment_notes: Source requires Parts A+B enrollment for all 60 months of a 5-year window centered on the index year (or until death). MVP execution approximates with Option B full-year A+B and HMO months = 0 in the reference year.

cohort.inclusion_notes: Age ≥68 at end of index year; FFS Parts A+B continuous window as published.
cohort.exclusion_notes: Medicare Advantage months in the window; disability/ESRD under-68 not in study population.

numerator.notes: Source uses multi-year IP/OP ICD claims algorithm; MVP approximates with MBSF sp_diabetes ∈ {1,2}.

estimand.notes: Crude national prevalence among eligible FFS beneficiaries.

result.notes: Published point estimate 31.6%. Text states margin of error <0.02% for all estimates; SE recorded as upper-bound MoE/100 ≈ 0.0002 (not a model-based SE).

assumptions: Year transport from 2015 evidence to 2021 MVP context does not recover 2015 Medicare.
Age ≥68 evidence filter applied at execution; Phase 1 worlds are generated with age ≥65 support.
MBSF sp_diabetes approximates—but does not reproduce—the Andes claims algorithm.

governance.rationale: Example-local calibration target for Andes→Drye researcher workflow. Does not alter frozen MVP corpus v1 partitions. Same point estimate and anchors as Phase 2 LIT-03 diagnostic formalization.
